notes: The 2002 format §2002:12.2.4.1 prints two independent brackets, SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name-1 ] [ WITH DEBUGGING MODE ] . (rendered, PDF p212 / folio 190), so the paragraph without computer-name-1 may carry the clause, and GR3 makes the compiling computer the source computer (no observable effect: computer-name-1 is not used for anything else). sourceComputerParagraph parses the clause after the name or without one; the name-less clause is the 2002 relaxation computer-name-optional-2002 (COBOL0900 at 85, where §1985:VI.4.3.2 nests the clause inside the name's bracket), the clause itself obsolete at 2002 (COBOL0903) and removed at 2014 (COBOL0902). The name-less clause keeps its GR4 effect: DebuggingLineRewriter.DeclaresMode reads it off the tokens, so debugging lines compile as source in the unit and its contained program (pb5609_debugging_mode_without_name: NO-NAME, DEBUG-ON, NESTED, NESTED-DEBUG). kb/Work PB5609.
